fightSong.title: Pick and Roll
fightSong.lyrics: Crack the shell, pick the meat / Baltimore boys don't accept defeat / Old Bay running through our veins / Crab Pickers in the fast lane!

stadium.name: The Crab Pot
stadium.tradition: The Mallet Smash — a giant wooden mallet cracks a ceremonial crab shell at midfield. The pieces spell the score prediction. It's wrong 60% of the time.

fanCulture.description: They bring actual mallets to games. After every third down stop, they do the 'crab shuffle' sideways. They put Old Bay on everything, including opponents.
fanCulture.tailgate: Steamed crabs on newspaper, Natty Boh, and arguments about the best crab cake.

rivalries.name: The Rust Belt Rumble
rivalries.narrative: Steel vs shell. They smelt, we pick. It's ugly, it's physical, it's perfect.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: CRAB PICKER TOUCHDOWN! That's a full bushel!

cityFlavor: Charm City with a chip on its shoulder. We work the water, we love our birds, and we season everything.
